description: MainActivity.java defines the main activity for an Android application. It manages the display of a fragment, toggles logging visibility, and initializes logging mechanisms with custom log handlers.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for the Android app, extending SampleActivityBase to provide common functionality. Handles UI setup, menu actions, and logging initialization.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when activity is created. Sets the content view and adds the SwipeRefreshMultipleViewsFragment if no saved state exists.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from a resource layout.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Dynamically updates menu items before the menu is displayed, toggling visibility and title based on current state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, specifically toggling the log display view.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up custom logging chain with wrappers, filters, and a log display fragment.
